title: Quintessence of Sand and Ritana
summary: Break the guardians' protection and handle Ritana's transfer of power to the Quintessence of Sand.
overview: Break the guardians' protection and handle Ritana's transfer of power to the Quintessence of Sand.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Plan Ritana's kill timing deliberately and keep control as the Quintessence becomes mobile.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The linked guardians share aggression and split into additional enemies when defeated.
Keeping Ritana alive until the Quintessence reaches 20% sets the bonus chest condition.
At that threshold the Quintessence unroots and becomes protected, while Ritana heals and becomes vulnerable.
Defeating the remaining linked guardians removes the Quintessence's protection so it can be finished.

notes: Approval E339. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
